svg.text: kukucs case v5 body: all sizes in mm, measured from the outside edges
TOP (shutter button) · front edge at the bottom
BOTTOM (seen from below) · front edge at the top, left and right swapped
Lens hole Ø5; BOOT and RESET pin holes Ø1.6
(RESET only reachable with the SD card out)
Keychain: Ø2.5 tunnel through the top-left corner
The microSD card sticks out 1.2 mm below the case
Antenna: 40 × 20 mm strip on the inside of the lid, left half (see antenna_route.png)
